cases.prompt: When did <TOP1> and I first text, and who texted first?
cases.grader_notes: GT date, direction, first-message text quoted verbatim

cases.prompt: What was the 10,000th message between me and <TOP1>?
cases.grader_notes: GT landmark row (skip to 1,000th if the chat is smaller -- GT picks the largest landmark that exists)

cases.prompt: What's the longest <TOP1> and I have gone without talking?
cases.grader_notes: GT gap duration + dates + reconnection message

cases.prompt: Do I have any texting anniversaries coming up?
cases.grader_notes: GT contacts in the 30-day window; min-100-msg floor respected

cases.prompt: When did I first mention "<PHRASE_HI>" to <TOP1>?
What's the last thing <SPARSE> sent me?
cases.grader_notes: GT last INBOUND message (their side; date/text) -- milestones firsts.last is the last message regardless of sender, so if the chat ends with my message the model needs a retrieval pivot; an answer quoting my own message as theirs = accuracy 0

cases.prompt: How far back does my message history go?
